notes.title: Sneak Peek: Upcoming Vehicles and WIP Features!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Tankers,[/b]
[b]More British vehicles will be coming your way! Along with some update on some exciting WIP features![/b]

[h2]Flying Elephant[/h2]
Nope, It can't fly but given the size of the tank, it is indeed an elephant! Well armored, it can easily lead the charge right into any opposition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/ebcfed2f89c01b73b6a6feb6e7dd29b8c68f0b17.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vev4KRX.gif[/img]

[h2]Austin Armored Car[/h2]
Why settle for 1 turret when you can have 2? This vehicle traded speed for more machine guns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/de18aeacf2f2abb2e76eb3d2050849a1667268e1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hm3YKBj.gif[/img]

[h2]Mine and Dynamite Launchers[/h2]
Having trouble dealing with enemy tanks or field guns? You will be able to equip all your vehicles with AT Mine, AP Mine or Dynamite Launchers in place of the default Smoke Grenade Launchers. Activate them via the steering panel and they will be tossed out from the rear of the vehicle.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vYhQYs0.gif[/img]

[h2]You can be Picasso![/h2]
We expanded the WIP in-game terrain editor with the ability to paint textures (Sand, Mud etc) and paint 3D grass and flowers. Pretty neat!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zAoh1PT.gif[/img]

[h2]Experimental AI Tank modules![/h2]
We are exploring on how to make fighting enemy tanks more than just a slug fest. Example, destroying modules will affect the performance of the tank (damaged engine will slow the tank, damaged ammo rack will slow the reload). AI tank will get more health but destroyed module will explode and do significant damage to the tank.
TLDR: Aim for modules to destroy enemy tanks more efficiently or Knock out the crews to disable it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aSR5beA.gif[/img]

Leave a comment or like if you love what you are seeing!

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Terrain Editor Tool
notes.content:
[b]Dear Tankers,[/b]
[b]We are very pleased to show you some of the very cool upcoming terrain editor tool features![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YTgorsH.gif[/img]
[i]No Terrain is too ROUGH!!![/i]

[h2]What can you do with the terrain editor tool?[/h2]
 You can easily sculpt the terrain using the brush with the mouse!

[h2]Adjust the height[/h2]
Using the Height brush, you can elevate or depress the terrain. Great for giving you the height advantage or sending the enemy straight to hell.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j0lsjxZ.gif[/img]


[h2]Flatten the curve[/h2]
Using the Flatten brush, you can set a height and paint the terrain to get a uniform height. Useful for making a bridge across the river without getting bitten by the crocodiles!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NF1DEuj.gif[/img]


[h2]Smooth It[/h2]
Got stuck on an uneven slope? No problem comrade, use the Smooth brush to smoothen out the rocky edges and you are good to go. You can try it out on your face too (result not guaranteed)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4e9QdTH.gif[/img]


Features that will be considered further down the road:
[list]
[*] Paint the terrain (grass, mud etc)
[*] Paint grass, flower
[*] Place barbed wires, buildings, trees etc
[/list]

Leave a comment or like if you love what you are seeing!

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Sandbox Game Mode
notes.content:
Dear Tankers,
We are very pleased to announce the new upcoming sandbox game mode!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QHvtYFq.gif[/img]

[h1]What is a sandbox game mode?[/h1]
The sandbox game mode will be a new addition to the game on top of the current campaign and custom battle. It is a hybrid of a editor/battle system where you can edit the mission in editor mode before hitting the start button. Once you are done battling, you can stop and get back to the editor.

[h1]What are the main features?[/h1]
The main features that will be in the first build are:
[list]
[*] Deploy units for Player and Enemy faction
[*] Wide range of units (Infantry, Crew served weapons, Tanks, Planes)
[*] 3 Type of AI (Defender - Hold Position, Defender - Attack Victory Point, Assault - Attack nearest enemy)
[*] Set Time of the battle (Dawn, Morning, Afternoon, Dusk, Night)
[*] Set Difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard)
[*] Choose the player vehicle (All tanks created in the garage will appear as a dropdown list for selection)
[*] Set the spawn point for player vehicle
[*] Save/Load mission
[/list]

Features that will be considered further down the road:
[list]
[*] Able to switch faction (You can play on the side of enemy)
[*] Able to deploy units of various nations
[*] Place barbwires, mines, resupply points, buildings etc
[*] Spawner to spawn units overtime
[*] Simple editor for scripted events
[*] Custom victory and defeat conditions
[*] Steamwork integration to upload/download sandbox mission save files
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fNx0ZZI.gif[/img]
[i]ARTILLERY ONLY!!![/i]

Do join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord [/url] to chat about the game and tanks!
Leave a comment or like if you love what you are seeing!

notes.title: Sneak Peek: RNAS Armored Car
notes.content:
Dear Tankers,
Today we will take a quick look at the upcoming speed demon!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SQzi7yG.gif[/img]

[h1]Background[/h1]
The first British armored car squadron was created by the Royal Naval Air Service (RNAS) in 1914. Rolls Royce Silver Ghost car chassis was modified with an armored body and a fully rotating turret to form the RNAS armored car.

Although the armored cars were not suited to the muddy and trench filled battlefields in the Western Front, they were put to good use in North Africa and were famously used by the Lawrence of Arabia against the Turkish.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/1530aab651aa6ad20d606370fe9ff2578b87daa3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Swappable Turrets[/h1]
A new feature that will come with the armored car is the ability to change the turret in the garage! RNAS armored car will come with 3 turrets.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5BpIvV7.gif[/img]

[h1]Turret 1[/h1]
A fully enclosed turret to provide maximum armor protection to the crew. The main drawback is the slow rotation speed of the turret.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/63c9ebbc894395397296724c26e586853ce218e2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Turret 2[/h1]
To adapt to the hot desert in North Africa, the roof of the turret is removed to improve air ventilation. This also increased the rotation speed of the turret.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/d0bba170c5944b0881947532a12ecbe40ed2bf6e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Turret 3[/h1]
In this version, the turret is replaced with a gun mount in an attempt to equip the armored car with a cannon. You can mount twin machine guns, cannons, and large flamethrowers. But beware as the turret has a limited arc of fire to the front.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/adbcdccf6a926a46150a5a137b96c3c2be771770.jpg[/img]

That's all for now.

Do join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord [/url] to chat about the game and tanks!
Leave a comment or like if you love what you are seeing!

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.content:
Hey Tankers! 
Today, we want to take you on a tour of a new variant of Mark V.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rfInUqj.gif[/img]

[h1]Background[/h1]
To counter the movement of British tank, the German started to widen their trenches. And the British solution to the problem is to lengthen the tank by cutting the tank in half and fit it with a almost 2m extension in the middle. The result will be Mark V*, in which the * indicates modification to the existing design (* is pronounced as Star). 

Ironically, the Mark V* was not converted from Mark V. They were rolled out as new vehicles from factories and much more Mark V* was constructed than the Mark V during world war one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/e4364cfd78fc73543da690b38f6ab792de11be9a.png[/img]

[h1]More of everything[/h1]
The main drawback is additional weight from the extension, which weighs about 4 tons. This resulted in much poorer maneuverability. 

The upside of Mark V* is the extra space available for:
[list]
[*] 2 additional storages are added to the rear. 
[*] 4 more gun ports are mounted (1 on each side and 2 on the rear top cab, facing forward and backward respectively). 
[*] Crew size grew from 6 to 8. This allows more guns to be manned!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/4714b7ad72e7d0f3ce2f21c8735d760ab1324cfb.png[/img]

[h1]Tactics[/h1]
Mark V* behaves like a slow moving bunker. With 8 crew, you can deliver massive amount of firepower on all direction of the tank. Very useful when enemy troops are swarming the tank from all directions. The extra 2 storages also allow you to hold more ammo and/or fuel. This reduces the need to frequent the resupply point.

You also have to be more selective of where to mount additional armor as any extra weight will result in sharp drop in mobility on a already slow vehicle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/5b7773e95bdfa64209dcca713bd41a2cd642fe98.png[/img]

[h1]New Module - Trooper Seat[/h1]
You can now swap the storage for a trooper seat! The trooper will serves as an additional crew in the tank and can be deployed via the sponson doors when the vehicle is in any of the Victory Point. Once deployed, you will lose control of the trooper so do weigh the options carefully.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/41473a80b531f365fe20678cfbb8d7aed2720653.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/b38c070c1d6f178a1b653a1807f1856a92e44f78.png[/img]
Tentatively, Mark V* will be coming by the end of the month!

Do join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord [/url] to chat about the game and tanks!
Leave a comment or like if you love what you are seeing!

notes.title: ABC 101: Crew and Crew Specialization
notes.content:
Hey Tankers! 

Today, we want you to meet the crew inside the tank!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXVFB4k.gif[/img]

[h1]Crew Members[/h1]
Each Crew Member in Armored Battle Crew is handcrafted and unique it his/her own way with both strengths and weaknesses. And taking the time to learn about them is critical to mission success!

There's [b]no permadeath[/b] system in Armored Battle Crew, so don't worry about your precious crew fading away! #notfeelingtoogood

Lastly, you have the ability to give your Crew Members nicknames if you so desire!

[h1]Roles[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/50e006373e76a1910c4116e127c4a9bc30e4f680.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/32b95c589b5cdfc7542f26ad394a95c0f2ce1de7.png[/img][/url]

Roles are recommended job scopes that we think the crew will fit. Example, gunner will have traits and abilities that make them a better gunner. But everyone is cross trained to operate the tank so every crew can fire weapon or drive the tank. It is just that some are more efficiently so choose wisely!

[h1]Barrack[/h1]
You can find all your crew resting in the barrack in the garage, awaiting your assignment. 
Each tank will have a fixed amount of crew slots. You can assign crew in the barrack to your tank crew slot by using the crew panel on the left.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/43b549c604c7c000fe56602986da98318f421dd3.png[/img]

[h1]Crew Management[/h1]
Other than driving the tank, most of the time you will be preoccupy with managing your crew. The success of each mission rely on your ability to micromanage the crew efficiently!

You can order the crew in the tank by use the following control:
[list]
[*] Left Mouse Button on any crew to select the crew
[*] Right Mouse Button on any module to order the selected crew to go to the module
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sTxrNSR.gif[/img]

Crew can perform the following actions:
[list]
[*] Operate module (weapon, steering, signal etc)
[*] Repair or put out fire on module
[*] Restock ammo
[*] Heal
[*] Revive fallen crew
[/list]
If you do feel overwhelmed, do not be despaired! We have added the following features to make your life easier:
[list]
[*] “R” to order your crew to pick up ammo and restock the weapon
[*] “H” to order your crew to heal himself/herself
[*] “Space” to toggle slow mo mode (x1 speed and x0.3 speed)
[/list]

[h1]Crew Statistic[/h1]
Each crew has the following stat:
[list]
[*] [b]Health.[/b] If the health reaches zero, the crew will drop onto the ground and is immobilized. If you can revive the fallen crew within a given time, he/she will recover and regain some health. If not, the fallen crew will be knocked out for the rest of the battle!
[*] [b]Armor.[/b] Additional armor can be equipped via crew specialization. It will help to reduce damage taken by the crew.
[*] [b]Movement speed.[/b] The overall speed of the crew when moving.
[/list]

[h1]Trait[/h1]
Traits are passive bonuses/penalties. Each crew will have a different set of strengths and weaknesses as defined by their traits.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/6d18851bf05dfe82bf082688639b3190276685a5.png[/img]
[i]Example of a negative trait.[/i]

[h1]Ability[/h1]
Traits are active bonus that can be activated in the battle. Each ability is tied to a role. Example, a gunner ability can only be activated on a weapon module. Ability will also have active and cooldown duration so timing is crucial.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/7f1dd33890de56912c13793402f322dfad4f986e.png[/img]
[i]Example of an ability.[/i]

[h1]Specialization[/h1]
Each crew will have 2 tracks of specialization and a total of 16 perks (8 perks per track). As the crew gains XP and level up, you will unlock and be able to choose 1 out of the 2 newly available perks. Each perk will give your crew a small bonus to the crew stat, trait or ability. You are free to change and customize to your liking anytime!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/a2df492b0c9f80070e8e6b4dc4e9c9cde4a0fe2c.png[/img]
[i]Some of the perks will visually alter your crew![/i]

Time to take a tea break. Stay tuned for more insight and be sure to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the game.

Like what you see? 
Leave a like and/or comment below or  join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord [/url] to chat about the game.

notes.title: Sneak Peek: British Mark V Tadpole
notes.content:
Hey Tankers! 
Today, we will introduce you to a rather fascinating variant of Mark V.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KgALKSz.gif[/img]

[h1]Tadpole, not Walpole?[/h1]
The German, facing the onslaught of British tanks in 1917, started to increase the width of their trenches in bid to impede the movement of tanks. To aid in the crossing of such widened trenches, the rear tracks are lengthened. The extra sections were dubbed the Tadpole Tail extension due to the shape and hence the name, Mark V Tadpole.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/f5c001bdba2baa1fa08938a3d5ced9579655ced8.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/b8a2b17ddb2a85a4a1ec6596c0f3876d25a316e4.png[/img]

[h1]Mobility[/h1]
The extra length allows Mark V Tadpole to cross widened trenches. But due to the increased weight, the tank has reduced speed. The additional track length also make the tank harder to steer, resulting in much slower rotation speed. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/6280991cae6a9100874e9db33034ea3e4447c7f4.png[/img]

[h1]Mortar[/h1]
Additional fire support was provided to the accompanying infantry by installation of a mortar on top of a platform at the rear of the extended tracks. In the game, the mortar can be accessed by the tank crew via the rear hatch. 

A wide range of weapons such as grenade launcher, small to large mortar are available. Do note that the rear gun port is removed and with the mortar being exposed, be sure that no enemy is sneaking behind your tank!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vAgL75r.gif[/img]

[h1]Tactics[/h1]
Due to the reduced mobility, you will have to make full use of the mortar to gain the upper hand in the battlefield. But be mindful as the medium to large sized mortars have long reload and eat ammo for breakfast. 

Resupplying can be a tricky affair as the tank is slow so do plan way ahead. Additionally, do watch out when navigating tight spaces in urban area due to the extra length of the tank. You would not want to get stuck in heat of action!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/8f86deefb54bd4772c298151e4b2b4d53a7dcb66.png[/img]

That’s enough for the day. Stay tuned for more insight and be sure to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the game so that you can be the first to try out the mighty mortar when the war starts!

notes.title: ABC 101: Signal Module, Smoke and Star Shell
notes.content:
Hey Tankers!

Today, we will be instructing you on the Signal Module, Smoke and Star Shells.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/dded3e61b4573db837b36b77f6170ebb31a09227.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/73561c4e6f7b8d71a4d58f8662f99638861533dd.png[/img]

[h1]Signal Module[/h1]
The Signal Module, when manned, provides 2 additional functionalities
[list]
[*] Extend the detection range on the minimap
[*] Access to Signal Support features via the Signal Module Panel
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/811cc322cfcbb6b3a87d81cb3cec69b23dc2eaa9.png[/img]
[i]Mark V's Signal Module[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/73561c4e6f7b8d71a4d58f8662f99638861533dd.png[/img]

[h1]Visual and Signal Range[/h1]
There are 2 detection ranges on the minimap. The shorter Visual Range is active by default until the Signal Module is manned, which activates the longer Signal Range.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/3d1fc37a06f1dbfbeba3e4da03458a04008fe32c.png[/img]
[i]Default Visual Range indicated in green.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/029a768b6a1ec3dee4bc72cc19cef419a6a50e3e.png[/img]
[i]Extended Signal Range also indicated in green when the Signal Module is manned.[/i]

Essential information on enemies' location and attack formation will only appear on the minimap when enemies are in the Visual or Signal Range. So we recommend you keep the Signal Module manned as much as possible!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/73561c4e6f7b8d71a4d58f8662f99638861533dd.png[/img]

[h1]Signal Support[/h1]
Signal Support as it name suggest supports your combat efforts. Each Signal Support type will come with 4 abilities with some of them even providing passive bonuses.

The type of Signal Support you bring into battle can be customised in the Garage. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/ba7d6c6151a08a05a08b9ae4b42214feadad496b.png[/img]
[i]Signal module panel with 4 abilities [/i]

Each support ability has an Activation Cost (Command Point), Active Duration and Cooldown Duration.

notes.title: ABC 101: Fuel and Flamethrower
notes.content:
Hey Tankers!

Today, we look at Armored Battle Crew's fuel system and the highly anticipated flamethrower!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lERecqu.gif[/img]
[i]Flamethrowers in action![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/73561c4e6f7b8d71a4d58f8662f99638861533dd.png[/img]

[h1]Fuel Consumption[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/55b48ad2f01f84c70236a2eab6f30d5d51ed766e.png[/img]
[i]Keep your eyes on the fuel meter![/i]

All vehicles require fuel to operate (duh), and a vehicle's fuel reserves are stored in the fuel tank. Naturally, the vehicle will no longer be drive-able when its fuel tank is empty.

Note: Engines with higher performance are usually fuel guzzlers and drain your fuel reserves faster. So, choose your engine wisely!

Engines also consume fuel at different rates depending on the vehicle's state
[list]
[*] Idle (very low amount overtime)
[*] Pivot steer (low amount)
[*] Driving (medium to high depending on speed)
[/list]

Due to the compact map design and relatively fast pace of ABC, the fuel consumption rate of engines have been set significantly higher when compared to their real life counterparts. This is done so you'll need to monitor your vehicle's fuel reserves. 

In typical real-life scenarios, a vehicle's fuel reserve would last over a few hours of driving before needing to refuel. However, in ABC fuel consumption is balanced so that the tank will require refueling at least once, or twice during each mission (30min average playtime).

[h1]Fuel as a Resource[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/867bdbde5c2a14402c46b4132cd5096061fd2194.jpg[/img]
[i]Fuel Storage[/i]

Fuel is a resource that can be stored in a Fuel Storage Module in the form of Fuel Cans. These cans are used to replenish the Fuel Tank or flamethrower.

The Fuel Storage Module and Fuel Tank can also be refilled/replenished using the following methods:
[list]
[*] Staying on Resupply Points scattered throughout the map
[*] Calling in Supply Drops via the Signal Module (Cost 50 Command Points)
[/list]

[h1]Flamethrower[/h1]
The Flamethrower or flammenwerfer, was first seen and used in WW1 by the Germans during the attack on Verdun in 1915. The device was powered by a pressurized fuel tank and was carried on the back of soldiers.

Upon activation, the pressurized gas forces fuel out of a long rubber tube. The fuel is then ignited by an igniter situated on the steel nozzle, at the end of the rubber tube. This projected a jet of flame over a short distance onto a target's position.

The British Army experimented with larger and static flamethrower setups, with one of them requiring a long tunnel to store the fuel tanks. Eventually, smaller and more portable devices, for example the Hay Flame Gun would be used by the British Navy during the Zeebrugge Raid in 1918. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/09da80c113f9095931db1f2f10460959270d6e98.jpg[/img]
[i]Small Flame Projector[/i]

There are 2 types of flamethrowers in ABC, Small and Large. The Small Flamethrower has a shorter range (15-20m), but can be mounted in the vehicle's gun port as a Light Weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/ff331db0f56744299dc609a396bf0d2706a56741.jpg[/img]
[i]Large Flame Projector[/i]

The Large flamethrower on the other hand, has an extended range (30-40m). Giving it a larger area of effect in exchange for slower reloading speeds. 

The flames shot from both flamethrowers travel in an arc, making them useful when engaging targets fully or partially behind cover. The flames are ineffective against enemy armor, but are devastating on exposed infantry.

Do note that the flamethrower uses Fuel as a resource, not your typical Light or Heavy ammo. So, be sure to have a Fuel Storage Module on board!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GSbSX78.gif[/img]
[i]This is what Fire Range is for![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/73561c4e6f7b8d71a4d58f8662f99638861533dd.png[/img]

That’s all for now! Stay tuned for more insight in ABC and be sure to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the game and be the first to set the battlefield on fire!

Also, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord[/url] to chat about the game and tanks!

If you like what you're reading/seeing, consider dropping us a like and comment!

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: Sneak Peek: British Mark V Family
notes.content:
Hey Tankers! 

Today, we will take a look at some Mark V variants.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GnaB5O4.gif[/img]
[i]Mark V Male firing the 6 Pounder![/i]

[h1]Mark V[/h1]
Although the Mark V is visually similar to it's predecessor, the Mark IV. It was, to a certain extent be considered a new design.

As previously mentioned in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/814740/announcements/detail/1741107428004204727]post[/url], the new engine and transmission were designed by Harry Ricardo and W.G. Wilson respectively. These upgrades increased efficiency and performance by providing 150 horse power and reducing the required crew from 4 to 1.

The rear cabin was also raised, providing the commander a better view of the battlefield.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/8384540aaa54455e862c6d0df8b219db9ffbf129.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Male[/h1]
The Male variant of the Mark V is equipped with two 6 pounder, 6 cwt cannons in the left and right sponsoons. With another 4 machine guns mounted around the tank (Front, Left, Right, Rear). 

In-game, the 6 pounders can be replaced with a full range of light and heavy weapons, making it quite versatile when it comes to offensive options. The biggest drawback of this variant is in the limited arc of fire on machine gun ports, making it hard to target enemies effectively.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/50a0fbc43d96fcea199400edc250ebaeffda326a.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/600af8f0b64cf491b311dd722e5088c7449ba38d.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Female[/h1]
The Female variant of the Mark V has 2 smaller turrets on each side of the sponsoons.

The small turret size limits this variant to only carrying Light Weapons, but provides a good arc of fire, allowing you to acquire and fire at enemy targets effectively.

There's also the option to mount up to 4 twin machine guns, making this tank variant devastating against enemy infantry and aircraft.

All in all, the female variant of the Mark V gives you better mobility (because of it's lighter load) better target acquisition (because of its superior arc of fire) but leaves you disadvantage against enemy tanks with Heavy Weapons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/4945fb6d251592b867f5c5aca53e290d7c82287c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/29155c495cb55fb5ea8a9e55ed6aa3e6ac1a1286.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Composite[/h1]
The Composite variant is a mix of the Male and Female variants, sporting both Male and Female sponsoons on either side. This hybrid design was implemented to equip Female tank variants with anti-tank capabilities.

The version of the Composite Mark V we have in-game has Male sponsoon on the right side and the Female sponsoon on the left.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/ade69e7fca5e90c7b231b0365184870d2b6d511b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/dd0eb1d5f66af1c5292458b6915da7f1d1dd35b5.png[/img]

This concludes the introduction to three variants of Mark V, with more being revealed in the weeks to come! More variants of the Mark V or completely new tanks you may ask? Well.. [b]Follow[/b] us, add us to [b]Wishlist[/b] and stay tuned to find out!

PS: Don't forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord[/url] to chat about the game and tanks!

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: ABC 101: Mark V Modules
notes.content:
Hey Tankers! 
Today, we want to give you a brief look over the modules in Mark V.

[h1]Mark V Weapon Modules[/h1]
Mark V tank is equipped with 6 weapon modules. 2 main turrets on the side sponsons and 4 gun ports, each facing front, rear, left and right respectively. 

The main turret can be armed with light and heavy weapon whereas gun port is restricted to only small light weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/538d706f252b0f02239079622563b23ea503db74.png[/img]

[h1]Light Weapons (Small)[/h1]
The Light Weapons class consists of Machine Guns, Small Cannons and Small Flamethrowers. They are fast to reload and have relatively high damage per minute. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/c1f267dec3e763fe86601332f61af16d268d981b.png[/img]

[h1]Light Weapons (Large)[/h1]
These are Light Weapon that are too big to be housed in a gunport and so, have to be be mounted on the 2 main turrets. They offer high burst damage but expend ammo quickly and are slow to reload!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/bdca4d06a5b0c77e3ee87f8391bb2acb6ab552e2.png[/img]

[h1]Light Ammo Storage[/h1]
Light Weapons as their name suggests need to be fed Light ammo. This generic ammo type can be obtained from the Light Ammo Storage bin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/1c70a4b2ff4a149cbc07a8e2cf09b374410744b3.png[/img]

[h1]Heavy Weapons[/h1]
The Heavy Weapons class consists of Auto Cannons, Medium to Large Cannon and Large Flamethrowers. They tend to be slow firing but deal massive damage per shot on target. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/777e387b6b15ea6035f9b62db07a46f29bb1a6b8.png[/img]

[h1]Heavy Ammo Storage[/h1]
As per its name, Heavy Weapons requires Heavy ammo. This generic ammo type can be obtained from the Heavy Ammo Storage. 

Be sure to use the right ammo for the right weapon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/f39f8533bb2490454e8fa5fd983923410eac8064.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Storage Modules[/h1]
4 Storage Modules are located near the rear of the tank. Each can be customised to store the following resources, Light Ammo, Heavy Ammo, Medical or Fuel. 

Light and Heavy Ammo storage have been explained earlier, so we'll just talk about Medical and Fuel storage.

Medical storage provides medic kits for healing and revival of fallen crew.

Fuel storage allows you to top up your fuel tank and extend the range of operation.Fuel also doubles as ammo for flamethrower, and It's up to you to a combination that best fits your playstyle or the mission objectives.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/7a31d3d47e3f08e850edd0fc5d1d8fd49f1ebc6e.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Engine[/h1]
One of the most significant upgrades of the Mark V over its predecessors. The underpowered 105 horsepower Daimler that generated a lot of smoke gave the position of the tank away was replaced by an engine designed by a young engineer, Harry Ricardo,

The new engine was able to produce 200 horsepower efficiently, but was dialed back to 150 horsepower to minimize strain on the transmission. Located at the front-center of the tank, the engine was easily accessible for emergency repair work within the tank in relative safety.

It was not all good though, The exposed engine generated a lot of noise and fumes during operation, making conditions in the tank unbearable for longer durations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/0ffa8117029fa8ab62677540b599f8773ebc2e74.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Fuel Tank[/h1]
The fuel tank of the Mark V is located at a relatively safe place, tucked at the back away of the tank away from the crew. The armored fuel tank has a capacity of 420 liters and held enough fuel for 72 km (45 miles) of operation.

In-game thought, the fuel consumption has be artificially increased to better fit the gameplay pacing and intensity. Pay attention to the fuel gauge so as not to run out in the middle of battle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/9b16c192c6ee8022a3bbda62fe6ab3eb4b59afd4.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Steering[/h1]
Another major upgrade of the Mark V over its predecessor is its steering. Compared to the older Mark I to Mark IV tanks, which required 4 crew members to drive and steer; The new epicyclic gearbox designed by Major W.G. Wilson, only required 1 crew member to fully operate the vehicle.

In-game, additional functionality such as a smoke grenade launcher can be accessed by the diver via the steering module.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/b27fd9bf758667886716181f6c98547f8e13206e.png[/img]

[h1]Mark V Tracks[/h1]
Tanks were critical to trench warfare, and to that purpose, the Mark V is equipped with a pair of tracks (width 52cm / 20.5 inch) that ran around the whole hull of the tank. Tracks do break due to a multitude of factors, stranding the tank until being fixed.

In the game, tracks do not break. Instead, idlers and sprockets can be damaged. There are 4 in total and with each damaged part results in a drop in mobility. Once all 4 are broken, the tank will come to a complete stand still.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/4e90d4099495d5d336e2dd975716e2590b59b157.png[/img]

Phew, that was a long one, and we will leave it at that for today.

Stay tuned for more insights into our development process and be sure to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the game and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord [/url] to chat about the game and tanks!

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: NEW Tank Alert! Whippet Good!
notes.content:
Hey Tankers!

Guess what?! A [b]NEW [/b]Tank joins the fray! (Among other things)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0SicpK4.gif[/img]
The Medium Mark A Whippet is the lighter and faster cousin of the Mark V Tank. It brings terror to the battlefield with a small 3 man crew, light weapons and extra mobility! Can you tame the whippet?

Here's the full update list.

[h1]New Aim Mode[/h1]
Think you can aim and shoot better than your crew? Take control and mow down the enemy.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QCcCXlh.gif[/img]

[h1]Revamped Signal Support[/h1]
Signal support has been re-balanced to serve more specific purposes. They can be called in from the signal module by using Command Points earned in battle.
[list]
[*] [b]Infantry  Rifle Corps[/b]
Call in troops to secure Victory Points. Can be helpful to turn the tide in your favor!

[*] [b]Royal Artillery Corps[/b]
Call in powerful artillery strikes. Expensive and long cooldown but decisive when used at the right moment!

[*] [b]Defense Tactics[/b]
Bonuses to vehicle health, resupply speed and capturing speed. Useful when supporting friendly infantry!

[*] [b]Infiltration Tactics[/b]
Allows your vehicle to capture Victory Points, awards bonuses to captured Command Points and calls in Trench Raiders to follow your vehicle! Great for penetrating enemy territory!
[/list]

[h1]New Campaign mission[/h1]
We have added a new mission, Hamel’s Doorstep. Assist the infantry in their assault to dislodge German resistance in the village of Hamel.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/8de79f98ffce1343c935e48f5e4a7285c400b08c.png[/img]

[h1]New Weapon[/h1]
[b]The Godsal Experimental AT Rifle[/b]
A new light weapon designed to combat enemy tanks. Provides good armor penetration, fast reload but relatively low damage. Can be repurposed as a close-mid range sniper rifle when needed.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/44d8b1947a1e6c532656d777ba5bf16e02e4df26.png[/img]

[h1]Slow Mo Feature[/h1]
We have added the highly requested feature to toggle speed between x1 and x0.3. Useful when micromanaging your crew!

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
More enemy threats spotted! Can you adapt to and defeat them?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33806715/c8eb33b8ae593765675eb96ef65c48bc46ebfdb8.png[/img]

As always join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord [/url] to contribute to the development of the game, and get you friends to Wishlist Armored Battle Crew if they haven't already!

Thanks a lot!
